summary: Card opened on Fabio's instruction while producing the western film in the Identity repo (MPI-74). H3 ref2v OOMs at 2K and 4K on a 32GB RTX 5090 because the VAE decode is not tiled. Kept deliberately small: tiled decode plus one low-VRAM toggle, no exposed tile tuning.

Moved todo -> done as REJECTED on Fabio's call. Premise disproven by reading the engine: the H3 video VAE sets handles_tiling=True (comfy/sd.py:957, tiles internally at 256px/17 frames) and plain VAEDecode already retries through _decode_tiled_owned on OOM (sd.py:1190-1213), so the existing VAE Decode node IS the tiled path. A tiled node also cannot be wired at all - an H3 LATENT is a NestedTensor(video, audio) and neither LTXVTiledVAEDecode (IndexError, 4D shape) nor core VAEDecodeTiled (TypeError on to()) unbinds it, unlike VAEDecode at nodes.py:333. Real reading of the 32GB OOM: decode tiled and still did not fit. Superseded by MPI-551's "Experimental - High VRAM" labelling; 864x480 + upscale stays the working route. Which stage OOMs was never measured - no Pod log.
Archived out of board.columns.done to .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/_archived/MPI-549/ (workspace preserved intact). mpi-archive run 2026-08-21.
